counting_notes: Input definition counts are the frozen project inventory, not full current online database sizes.
Composition links are overlapping context relations, not equality merges, and cannot be added across libraries.
Bound score dimensions include unknown applicability or no observed values; measured columns report at least one demo patient.
Library definitions, score method resources and patient platforms have separate denominators.
SOURCE_TASK_ROLES predates the added WikiPathways composition definitions; this inventory uses DEFINITION_TO_IDENTITY for input counts.
PHOSPHO PTMsigDB definitions may have no measured RPPA signature although they are registered.
State resource families are an explicit grouping of algorithms/publications, not a claim of separate databases.
